data.title: ETC Awarded $11.7 Million in Contracts
data.description: Environmental Tectonics Corporation (OTCID: ETCC) revealed that it secured contracts worth $11.7 million. The initial contract involves upgrading the US Navy Spatial Disorientation research device, while the second contract pertains to providing a Hypobaric Chamber for an overseas client. Furthermore, ETC Sterilizations Systems Unit received a contract from an international medical device maker for constructing and setting up a substantial vacuum drying chamber. The agreements mark a significant milestone for the company, showcasing its success in securing valuable contracts across diverse sectors.
